name: Inverted Row
cues: Set the bar in the rack at about waist height
Hang under it with your body straight and heels on the floor
Pull your chest to the bar
Bend your knees to make it easier

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-08 (delegated to the lead). Earlier: v1.x fix 2026-10-08, re-review. Camera moved to the feet end (az -30, elev 0.2): at -50 the near upright crossed the head for half the loop (a scene test now checks hands and head). The rack is framed by its base, so the figure is larger and the uprights run out of the top (407 precedent). Unchanged: the upper back faces the floor, so the lats show as an edge; the top elbow is 141 deg (1.3x grip).
